main.p: Legal

Welcome to Summa Flow Ltd. ("Summa Flow," "we," "us," or "our"). We are registered in Hong Kong and operate an AI-powered platform designed to extract, organize, and present logistics and project intelligence from authorized email and messaging communications.

Protecting your privacy and the confidentiality of your communications is our highest priority. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, use, process, and protect your information when you access our website, use our application, and connect your email, Microsoft Graph, Google Gmail, IMAP, or WhatsApp accounts to our service.
By using Summa Flow, you agree to the data practices described in this policy.
To provide our service, we collect different categories of information, ranging from your basic account details to the data processed by our AI.
When you create an account or subscribe to our service, we collect personal details necessary to manage your profile and billing.

ul.li: Contact Information: First name, last name, and email address.
Billing Information: Payment processing details (handled securely via our third-party payment processors; we do not store your full credit card numbers).

main.p: To extract logistics and project intelligence, you must grant us access to your email account via OAuth (for example, Google Workspace/Gmail or Microsoft 365).

ul.li: Authentication Tokens: We store OAuth access and refresh tokens that allow SummaFlow to keep syncing authorized accounts until you disconnect the provider. We never request, view, or store your email password for OAuth providers.

Google Gmail Data: When you connect Google, SummaFlow requests https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly to view Gmail messages and settings needed to import inbox and sent email, including sender, recipients, subject, timestamps, labels, message identifiers, message body content, and supported attachments.

Microsoft Graph Data: When you connect Microsoft, SummaFlow requests offline_access, User.Read, and Mail.Read to read your profile and authorized mailbox messages and to continue syncing while the connection remains enabled.

Email Content: We access and may store sender, recipient, subject line, timestamps, message IDs, folder/label data, supported attachment metadata, and extracted project intelligence. Raw email body text/HTML is used for processing and is not retained in production storage.

main.p: Like most SaaS platforms, we automatically collect basic technical information when you interact with our website to ensure security and monitor performance.

ul.li: Device and Usage Data: IP addresses, browser types, operating systems, and timestamp data.
Cookies: Small data files stored on your device to keep you logged in and track basic platform performance.

main.h2: 3. How We Process and Store Your Data
main.p: Because we handle sensitive communications, we limit connected-account data to the information needed to provide sync, classification, project matching, summaries, support, security, and deletion workflows.

When our system accesses an email or message from a connected account, raw message body content is processed for classification, project linking, and summary generation. In production, SummaFlow does not retain raw email body text or raw email HTML after this processing step.

ul.li: Email records retained by SummaFlow can include sender, recipients, subject, timestamps, message IDs, folder/label data, provider account identifiers, and generated AI metadata.
Project outputs retained by SummaFlow can include summaries, status labels, project links, structured attributes, and reference snippets generated from the processing step.
We use connected-account data only to provide SummaFlow's project intelligence, operational ledger, sync, support, security, and compliance functions.

main.h3: 3.2 Storage of Tokens, Metadata, and Extracted Intelligence
main.p: We store OAuth tokens, message metadata, AI classification responses, project links, structured project intelligence, and generated summaries for as long as needed to provide the service or satisfy verified deletion requests. Provider disconnect clears stored OAuth tokens and stops future sync, but it does not automatically delete generated summaries that were previously created.
Production deployments should use HTTPS, access controls, infrastructure-level encryption at rest, credential isolation, and database backup controls appropriate for sensitive communication data.
We utilize advanced third-party language models to perform the extraction of logistics data.

Selected communication text, metadata, and extracted attachment text may be sent securely via API to Gemini, an AI model provided by Google. The data is analyzed for logistics intelligence, and the results are returned to our system.

We use AI providers to process data only for the SummaFlow service. SummaFlow does not use your email data to train, fine-tune, or improve generalized AI models. We configure third-party AI processing according to the applicable API terms and data-processing controls available for those services.

Summa Flow's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We explicitly affirm that:

ul.li: We only use access to read your emails to provide the core extraction features of the platform.
We do not use your email data for serving advertisements.
We do not sell Google user data, Microsoft Graph data, or derived project intelligence.

We do not allow humans to read your data unless we have your affirmative agreement for specific support messages, doing so is necessary for security purposes, or it is required to comply with applicable law.

main.p: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information, raw emails, or extracted logistics data to data brokers, advertisers, or any unauthorized third parties. In production, raw email body text/HTML is processed but not retained. We only share information under the following limited circumstances:

ul.li: Service Providers: We share necessary data with trusted vendors who support our platform (e.g., cloud hosting providers like AWS/Google Cloud, payment processors, and the Gemini API). These providers are bound by strict confidentiality agreements.
Legal Compliance: We may disclose data if required to do so by law, or in response to a valid request by public authorities (e.g., a court order or subpoena) within our jurisdiction of Hong Kong.

Business Transfers: If Summa Flow Ltd. is involved in a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your data may be transferred, provided the receiving party agrees to uphold the privacy standards set in this policy.

main.p: You have complete control over your data.

ul.li: Active Accounts: We retain your account information and extracted logistics data, message metadata, and generated summaries for as long as your account or workspace is active, unless a shorter retention period is configured or a verified deletion request is completed.
Account Deletion: You may delete your account and revoke our OAuth tokens at any time through your account settings or by contacting support.

30-Day Backup Cycle: After a verified deletion request is completed, production records are removed according to our operational process. Encrypted system backups may retain deleted data for up to 30 days before backup expiration.

main.p: Summa Flow Ltd. is headquartered in Hong Kong. By using our service, you acknowledge that your information may be transferred to, processed, and stored in jurisdictions outside of your home country (including where our cloud servers and AI APIs are hosted). We employ industry-standard encryption and legal safeguards to ensure your data remains protected regardless of where it is processed.
Depending on your location, you may have specific rights regarding your personal data:

ul.li: Access: You may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Correction: You may update or correct inaccurate data via your dashboard.

Revocation of Consent: You can revoke our access to your inbox at any time by disconnecting the provider inside SummaFlow or by navigating to your email provider's security settings, such as Google Account permissions or Microsoft app consent settings.
Deletion: You can request the total erasure of your account and associated data.

main.p: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information below.

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our technology, legal requirements, or business operations. If we make material changes, we will notify you by email or by posting a prominent notice on our platform prior to the change becoming effective.
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
